source_of_data: Synthetic demonstration transactions generated by src.data
audit_fixes: Numeric missing values are retained during validation and imputed within the modeling pipeline so preprocessing statistics are fit on training rows only.
Classification thresholds are selected using validation predictions; final metrics are calculated on a separate held-out test split.
limitations: Synthetic demonstration data only; metrics do not represent real financial fraud performance.
The split is stratified at transaction-row level; production work should include temporal and customer-aware validation.
Thresholds must be selected based on institution-specific fraud costs, review capacity, and policy.
